sloka: इति पादातयोधाश्च हस्त्यश्वारोह बन्धका: ।अनाथास्तं विधिं लब्ध्वा वाचमेतामुदैरयन् ॥ २.९१.५९॥
transliteration: iti pādātayodhāśca hastyaśvāroha bandhakā: ।anāthāstaṁ vidhiṁ labdhvā vācametāmudairayan ॥ 2.91.59॥

translations.english: All the armymen with their desires gratified and anointing their bodies with red sandal paste surrounded by apsaras exclaimed.
